offers.sn: About the role We are seeking a Senior Networking Engineer with deep expertise in data-center networking, routing, and high-throughput packet delivery to join our Operations team in Copenhagen, working side by side with our SRE team.
offers.rq: 5+ years in a Network Engineering, Network Reliability, or Infrastructure Engineering role As we collaborate across locations, English is our primary language. Please submit your CV in English to support the review process.

offers.sn: Hos itm8 leder vi efter en tung profil, der kan tage ejerskab for netværksleverancerne i Aalborg og være med til at bygge vores netværksfunktion op lokalt.
offers.rq: Har solid erfaring (gerne 10+ år) og har drivet til at tage ansvar fra dag ét
